title: Senior Staff Automation Engineer
eligibility_reason: listed at Pawtucket, RI (In-Office) but the description says remote; check
description:
Acute Care Technology At ZOLL, we're passionate about improving patient outcomes and helping save lives. We provide innovative technologies that make a meaningful difference in people's lives. Our medical devices, software and related services are used worldwide to diagnose and treat patients suffering from serious cardiopulmonary and respiratory conditions.
The Acute Care Technology division of ZOLL Medical Corporation develops and delivers innovative lifesaving products and software solutions to EMS, hospital, public safety, and military customers globally. Products include AEDs, trauma kits, ventilators, temperature management solutions, and more. Our dedicated employees take pride in their commitment to improving patient outcomes while delivering world-class customer service.
At ZOLL, you won't just have a job. You'll have a career—and a purpose.
Join our team. It's a great time to be a part of ZOLL!
Job Type
On Site
Job Summary
Design, develop and implement systems, processes, controls, coding, testing and documentation for all aspects of automation. Interface, collaborate, and manage projects with 3rd party automation companies and procurement processes for capital equipment.
Essential Functions
Design and develop automated systems and processes.
Interface, collaborate, and manage projects with 3rd party automation companies and procurement processes for capital equipment.
Collaborate with other engineers and stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver solutions that provide value to the customer.
Conduct risk assessments and ensure compliance with safety standards.
Identify, select, and manage vendor and integrator relationships in support of project objectives.
Simulate and test automation processes to ensure functionality.
Integrate IT and OT systems to ensure seamless communication between different technology layers.
Program and code automation software solutions.
Develop comprehensive documentation packages for all aspects of the automation process, including development and implementation.
Conduct factor acceptance testing and/or site acceptance testing as appropriate to ensure system requirements are met.
Create and maintain project timelines and budgets.
Identify and resolve system malfunctions and inefficiencies.
Provide technical support and training to end-users.
Lead root cause analysis and corrective actions for system failures.
Develop and implement process control strategies.
Continuously monitor and upgrade existing automation systems for improved performance.
Evaluate new technologies and tools to enhance automation capabilities.
Required/Preferred Education and Experience
Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Mechanical/Electrical, Computer Science or related discipline is required
Master's Degree preferred
10+ years of Automation Engineering experience in a manufacturing environment is required
Experience interfacing, collaborating, and managing projects with 3rd party automation companies and procurement processes for capital equipment is required
Experience and understanding of machine validation IQ/QQ/PQ is required
Demonstrated experience with PLC, HMI, MES is required
Experience with industrial and collaborative robotics is required
Experience in defining requirements (design, functional, user) for automation systems is required
Experience in project management and coordination is required
Experience with computer vision and AI applications in automation is required
Experience working within strict quality systems and regulated manufacturing environment is required
Experience with converting and/or printing equipment is preferred
Experience in medical device manufacturing/industry is preferred
Experience with converting equipment is a plus
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
Strong programming and scripting skills (e.g., Python, Java, C++, Lab View, Allen-Bradley, Siemens).
Demonstrated ability to consistently deliver high profile projects on time with quality results.
Understanding of cybersecurity principles related to industrial automations.
Excellent communication, collaboration and interpersonal skills.
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Ability to troubleshoot and repair automated equipment.
Familiarity with industry standards and safety protocols.
Computer skills using Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Outlook, Teams, Word, PowerPoint, Project), Jira, Minitab, SolidWorks or Creo.
Ability to influence product design, to optimize Design for Automated Assembly (DfAA).
Preferred Languages
English - Advanced
Travel Requirements
20% Travel to facilities to interface, collaborate, manage projects, attend meetings and/or training.

Working Conditions

Extreme heat - Occasionally

ZOLL is a fast-growing company that operates in more than 140 countries around the world. Our employees are inspired by a commitment to make a difference in patients' lives, and our culture values innovation, self-motivation and an entrepreneurial spirit. Join us in our efforts to improve outcomes for underserved patients suffering from critical cardiopulmonary conditions and help save more lives.
